From: lukas_meyer@redwood.inference
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@brightgrid.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.inference
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG delegation + subservice integration onboarding (BrightGrid)

Hi Alex —

Quick note to kick off the security onboarding for the BrightGrid connector integration. We have a small set of subservices (S3 presigned uploads + webhook consumer) that you asked to include in the SIG/CAIQ scope. To make the portal upload and claim process smooth, two asks from our side: 

1) Can BrightGrid delegate the subservice claim for "brightgrid-s3-ingest" in your Vendr/Whistic org? We can accept a delegated claim (SIG CSV + CAIQ answers) and map it to our main account.

2) For S3 proof, please provide either a short presign-runbook or temporary object listing (no binary). We usually accept: bucket name, prefix used for uploads, example presign TTL, and an ACL statement. A simple CSV or a short text file is fine.

Attached a small delegation template that speeds the process. ETA from our side: once we have the delegated claim + S3 details we can complete the SIG mapping within 48 hours and move you to the Canaries rollout for the connector.

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync tomorrow if that works to confirm owners and the PO/procurement timeline.

Thanks,
Lukas Meyer
Senior Manager, Security Integrations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sig-delegation-template.pdf (PDF)]
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@brightgrid.com>

Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@brightgrid.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightgrid.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG delegation + subservice integration onboarding (BrightGrid)

Hi Lukas —

Thanks for the clear outline. We can do delegated claims from our Vendr instance. A couple clarifying points before we flip anything on: 

- The S3 bucket for ingest is in our prod account (brightgrid-prod-uploads). We usually don't send full manifests; I'll provide the sample CSV you mentioned (bucket, prefix, example presign TTL).
- For delegation: who at Redwood needs to be listed as the designated claim receiver? We want to lock the delegation to a specific group or userid instead of a broad org-level permission.

Also looping Samir from our infra team for the S3 details and procurement to flag any PO timing constraints. We are available for a sync tomorrow at 10am PT.

Alex
Director of Integrations
BrightGrid

Alex / Samir —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple implementation notes from our portal/evidence side: 

- Delegation target: please delegate to claims@redwood-inference.ops (that address maps to our Vendr steward group). We require the delegation to include an expiration (we typically accept 180d with auto-renew OK).

- Evidence mapping: when you upload the SIG CSV, include a short mapping file that states the question id -> component mapping (e.g., Q3.2 -> brightgrid-s3-ingest). That lets us apply differential rollouts.

- S3 proof guidance (minimum fields):
  * bucket: brightgrid-prod-uploads
  * prefix: /redwood-ingest/
  * sample-presign-ttl: 1h
  * ACL: private

I'll attach a brief presign instruction snippet we use for customers; Samir, if you can drop the CSV sample there that would be perfect.

Mina is cc'd to track SOC2 linkage in our portal so we don't miss CAIQ crosswalk items.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Portal Operations
Redwood Inference

Procurement note: procurement@brightgrid.com — we expect to begin connector activation after signature on the amendment; if you need a PO to start work, let us know the invoice cadence.
